product_model.lists: removed from the current product IA and storage model
product_model.notifications: internal/backing capability only; no primary navigation page

data_model.browser_cache: IndexedDB acceleration cache with dirty-store persistence
data_model.release_ai_summary: latest Release summary stored on D1 repositories; Release body and assets cached in browser

sync.optimistic_mutations: server acknowledgement does not force an immediate full Bootstrap
sync.bootstrap: waits for pending writes and repeats snapshots that overlap a write
sync.release_and_fork: last attempt and outcome stored in settings; last success advances only on a complete successful sync
sync.preferences: patch only supplied fields; release rule fields merge atomically in D1

performance.repository_cards: content-visibility auto with intrinsic sizing for offscreen rendering
performance.indexeddb: rewrites only changed entity stores and coalesces rapid writes
performance.d1: indexes for starred repository Bootstrap and release ordering
performance.page_loading: five lazy feature pages with chunk failure recovery
performance.assets: content-hashed JS/CSS with immutable caching; build statistics traverse static dependencies

verification.local: npm run check:installed (typecheck, tests, build, COSS structural gate)
verification.browser_visual_smoke: Playwright interaction suite is available separately via npm run test:browser
verification.worker: local D1 runtime smoke, Wrangler dry-run packaging and native binding compatibility checks

ui_contract.design_system: COSS local primitives + Base UI behavior + Phosphor Icons + Border Beam analysis effect

architecture.worker: thin entry, central router, domain routes, SQL mutation planner and D1 transaction execution
architecture.shared: domain/wire contracts, preference validation, release platform rules and client metadata
architecture.client_api: session-aware abortable request lifecycle and consistent Bootstrap snapshots
